```{=html}
<section class="bs-cheatsheet" aria-label="Chapter summary cheat sheet">
  <header class="bs-cs-head"><div><div class="bs-cs-eyebrow">Quick reference</div><div class="bs-cs-title">Measures of Association</div></div></header>
  <div class="bs-cs-grid">
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">01 · Direction</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">The Covariance</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">s<sub>xy</sub> = Σ(x<sub>i</sub> − x̄)(y<sub>i</sub> − ȳ) / (n − 1)</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Measures the <b>direction</b> of the linear relationship. Its magnitude depends on the units of the data, so it is not comparable across data sets.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=COVARIANCE.S(A1:A10,B1:B10)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">02 · Strength & Direction</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">The Correlation</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">r = s<sub>xy</sub> / (s<sub>x</sub> · s<sub>y</sub>)</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Standardizes the covariance to the range [−1, 1]. It is <b>unit-free</b> and captures both the strength and direction of the linear relationship.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=CORREL(A1:A10,B1:B10)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">03 · Explained Variation</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Coefficient of Det.</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">R<sup>2</sup> = r<sup>2</sup></div><p class="bs-cs-desc">The percent of the variation in <i>y</i> explained by <i>x</i>. Ranges from 0 (no relationship) to 1 (a perfect linear fit).</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=CORREL(A1:A10,B1:B10)^2</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">04 · Visualize</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Scatter Diagram</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">plot the (x, y) pairs<br/>as points</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Shows the shape, direction, and strength of a relationship at a glance. Add a linear trend line to summarize the pattern.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>Insert → Charts → Scatter</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">05 · Building Block</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Standard Deviation</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">s<sub>x</sub> = √[ Σ(x<sub>i</sub> − x̄)² / (n − 1) ]</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Correlation divides the covariance by the product of the two standard deviations, s<sub>x</sub> and s<sub>y</sub>.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=STDEV.S(A1:A10)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">06 · Sample vs Population</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Covariance Variants</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">sample: ÷ (n − 1)<br/>population: ÷ N</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Use the <b>.S</b> version when your data is a sample and the <b>.P</b> version when it is the entire population.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=COVARIANCE.P(A1:A10,B1:B10)</span></div></article>
  </div>
  <div class="bs-cs-panels">
    <div class="bs-cs-panel"><div class="bs-cs-panel-title">Notation Guide</div><dl>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>s<sub>xy</sub></dt><dd>Sample covariance</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>r</dt><dd>Correlation coefficient</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>R<sup>2</sup></dt><dd>Coefficient of determination</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>s<sub>x</sub> , s<sub>y</sub></dt><dd>Standard deviations of x, y</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>x̄ , ȳ</dt><dd>Sample means</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>n , N</dt><dd>Sample / population size</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Σ</dt><dd>Summation</dd></div>
    </dl></div>
    <div class="bs-cs-panel"><div class="bs-cs-panel-title">Key Facts</div><dl>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Positive covariance means?</dt><dd>Direct relationship</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Negative covariance means?</dt><dd>Inverse relationship</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Range of the correlation?</dt><dd>−1 to +1</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>r = 0 means?</dt><dd>No linear relationship</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Strong relationship?</dt><dd>|r| close to 1</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Is correlation unit-free?</dt><dd>Yes</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>R² of 0.79 means?</dt><dd>79% of variation in y explained</dd></div>
    </dl></div>
  </div>
</section>
```
